outcome.reason: Customer is disputing a Rs 12,000 unauthorized charge and refuses to pay until investigation is complete.

transcript.text:
Good afternoon! I’m calling from Mumbai Bank regarding your overdue credit card payment. I noticed there’s an outstanding balance on your account, and I’m here to help you resolve it. Please note, continued non-payment may negatively impact your credit score and could lead to legal action.

Could you please let me know when you’ll be able to make your payment? If you’re facing any difficulties, I’m here to assist you and can discuss possible discounts or waivers if needed.
Good afternoon. I just want to say upfront, there’s a charge of Rs 12,000 on my account that I absolutely did not make. I’m not paying a paisa until you properly investigate that transaction.

Thank you for letting me know. I understand your concern regarding the Rs 12,000 charge. I will immediately initiate an investigation into this transaction for you. 

In the meantime, I recommend making at least the minimum payment (excluding the disputed amount) to avoid further late fees or impact on your credit score, but I respect your decision to wait for the outcome of the dispute.

Can you briefly describe the transaction you’re disputing, such as the date and merchant, to help us resolve this quickly? I will escalate your dispute right away.

Look, I already told you I didn't make that transaction. I don’t even know where or when it happened. Just look into your records and sort it out. I’m not going to pay anything until you clear this up.
